digest.component_or_area: pytest timeout mechanism and CI workflow configuration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was reduced from 300s to 20s (commit 6a5c88027c5), but legitimate whole-tree-scan tests on the coverage-instrumented CI leg cost 18.7–29.93s, placing the budget inside the band of legitimate test costs.

With timeout_method=thread, a budget expiry executes os._exit(1) from the watchdog thread, killing the xdist worker outright, so no test records a Failed: Timeout verdict; only signal method reports timeouts as failures.

Worker crashes accumulate due to --dist loadgroup re-dispatching the crashing test to respawned workers, burning the job's time budget and causing silent test-count reductions (16175 vs 16182 passed).

A patchset-only config fix to pyproject.toml is ineffective on its own Verified gate because the Verified workflow executes _build-and-test.yml from trusted main, where the stale CLI --timeout=20 flag overrides the patchset's ini change.

The fix restores timeout=300 in pyproject.toml ini and explicitly in both shared-tier _build-and-test.yml lanes (--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread), providing ~10x headroom above the 29.93s measured worst case.
